args.body:
- Apparel return rates reached 24% in 2026, making returns a major cost driver for retail logistics (source: blog.ironbark.example/2026/returns).
- Consolidating returns into centralized return hubs cut handling costs by roughly a fifth (~20%) (source: blog.ironbark.example/2026/returns).
- Reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the original margin, per the companion piece (source: insights.ironbark.example/returns/companion).
args.title: Ironbark 2026 Returns Articles — Combined Summary
